cases.question_original: Curentul din circuitul statoric al unui generator crește direct proporţional:

sources.title: Schneider Electric Electrical Installation Guide, Definition of reactive power
sources.short_evidence: For balanced sinusoidal 3-phase power, S²=P²+Q² and S=√3 UI; specify fixed P, Q, U or power factor before claiming direct proportionality.

cases.key_uncertainty: The question does not state fixed P, Q, U, power factor, or generator operating mode; unconditional direct proportionality cannot be inferred.
math_regression: if P=3,Q=8,U=1 I=sqrt(73)/sqrt(3), not 2* previous I

cases.question_original: Două funcţii periodice sinusoidale sunt armonice între ele dacă:

options_original.A: raportul perioadelor lor este un număr întreg oarecare
options_original.C: raportul perioadelor lor este egal cu 1/2

sources.title: UNSW Physics: How harmonic are harmonics?
sources.section: nth harmonic frequency nf and second-harmonic period T/2
sources.short_evidence: nth harmonic frequency is n times the fundamental; T_n=T_1/n. For n=2, T_n/T_1=1/2 while T_1/T_n=2.

sources.title: Tektronix harmonics in measurement
sources.short_evidence: Test-equipment examples identify 10 kHz fundamental and 20,30 kHz harmonics; not a source for ANRE answer scoring.

cases.key_uncertainty: Unspecified orientation of 'raportul perioadelor', possible n=1 inclusion, and nonexclusive option overlap make A/B/C not unconditionally mutually exclusive.
assumptions_to_check: whether identical frequencies count as first harmonic
whether question requires a distinct harmonic

cases.question_original: Fluxul electric total, produs de o sarcină electrică de valoare q printr-o suprafaţă închisă care o înconjoară, este egal cu:

sources.title: OpenStax University Physics Volume 2, 6.2
sources.section: 6.2 Gauss law for E: integral E dot dA=q_enc/epsilon0
sources.short_evidence: In SI units the closed-surface flux of electric-field intensity E is q enclosed divided by vacuum permittivity.

sources.title: Virginia Tech Electromagnetics, Section 5.5
sources.section: Gauss law for electric flux density D: integral D dot ds=Q_encl
sources.short_evidence: Closed surface flux of electric flux density D is enclosed charge (in C); D is not the same object as E.

cases.key_uncertainty: Original question says 'flux electric total' but does not identify E or D and original choices omit q/epsilon0. Option B=q requires D-flux/older convention; not a safe direct reading of E.
assumptions_to_check: which field is integrated E or D
whether q is free or total charge
math_regression: q=1 C: E flux in vacuum numerically 1/epsilon0, not 1
q=1 C of free charge: D flux 1 C
